q_en: When is the first day of school and registration for 2026-27?
a_en: The first day of school is September 13, 2026, which is also in-person registration day at the office. We no longer accept registration by mail.
a_zh: 2026年9月13日開學，當天請到辦公室辦理註冊。我們不再接受郵寄註冊。

q_en: How do I register my child? Is there an online portal?
q_zh: 如何為孩子註冊？有網上註冊嗎？
a_en: New families sign up and returning students sign in through the registration portal at https://register.sandiegochineseschool.com (also reachable from the Enroll page). Questions: Office.SDCA@gmail.com or (858) 205-7322.
a_zh: 新家庭註冊與舊生登入請使用註冊網站 https://register.sandiegochineseschool.com（也可從註冊頁面進入）。如有問題請洽 Office.SDCA@gmail.com 或 (858) 205-7322。

q_en: Where is the school and when are classes held?
a_en: SDCA meets on Sunday afternoons at La Jolla Country Day School in La Jolla. Mailing address: P.O. Box 910093, San Diego, CA 92191-0093. Please do not call La Jolla Country Day School; call the SDCA office instead.
a_zh: 學苑於週日下午在拉荷亞鄉村日校 (La Jolla Country Day School) 上課。郵寄地址：P.O. Box 910093, San Diego, CA 92191-0093。請勿致電拉荷亞鄉村日校，請聯絡學苑辦公室。

q_en: How do I contact the school office?
a_en: Email Office.SDCA@gmail.com or call (858) 205-SDCA (7322). You can also text @sdcaparent to 81010.
a_zh: 電郵 Office.SDCA@gmail.com，或致電 (858) 205-SDCA (7322)。也可傳簡訊 @sdcaparent 至 81010。

a_en: SDCA teaches Mandarin and Chinese culture from Pre-K to Grade 12, plus adults. Class types: Pre-K, ZhuYin, PinYin, Regular, Bilingual, Credit and Adult classes.
a_zh: 學苑提供學前班到十二年級及成人的中文與文化課程，班級包括：學前班、注音班、拼音班、普通班、雙語班、學分班、成人班。
